boundary: Post-generation researcher audit of authored development fixtures. No new API calls, no independent holdout, no human usability study, no inspection of actual media pixels/files in this audit. Source support is checked against supplied corpus text and full per-answer source context.

rubric.semantic_context: supported: supplied context warrants prose at stated scope; qualified: main idea related but scope/qualification enlarged or missing; unsupported: a substantive assertion is not warranted or is contradicted by source context.
rubric.structural_quote: Exact, case-sensitive contiguous substring in one cited source body. Valid IDs are separate. Combining passages from different sources into one quote fails even when prose is sound.
rubric.origin: Explicit controlled/constructed/public-reuse source origin must remain inspectable and disclosed as requested by generator instruction. Missing disclosure is reported separately; promoting constructed metadata into actual provenance is a substantive semantic failure.
rubric.completeness: Does answer address question and uncertainty, and does extra prose contradict or undermine the answer? Not merely matching must/forbid substrings.
rubric.independence: Different researcher than fixture/generation author, but after-the-fact, nonblind review on the same development corpus; no statistical independence or held-out accuracy claim.

summary.do_not_pool: Separate quote validity, semantic context, constructed provenance, and question completeness; none is general accuracy.
